app.title: Cloudflare OS: an open platform for agents, apps, and work
app.author: speckx
app.description: Cloudflare OS is an open platform for building, deploying, and managing cloud-native applications.
proposed_tests: Install Cloudflare OS CLI and create a new deployment
Write a simple service using Cloudflare OS's API
Test service deployment and scalability using Cloudflare OS
Compare Cloudflare OS's performance with other cloud platforms
